devices.name: MOTION SENSOR
devices.look: A passive infrared sensor on a stand. It sees heat move. It has watched a lot of technicians leave at 17:00.
devices.status: SENSE · raises motion · wired to the test lamp

say: DEVICE UNDER TEST: MOTION SENSOR. KIND: SENSE. IT NOTICES. IT DOES NOT ACT. EVENT: motion → TEST LAMP (PRE-WIRED).

devices.name: TEST LAMP
devices.look: A bulb in a wire cage on a clamp. The most tested bulb in the city.

devices.name: MEMO SCREEN
devices.look: A small screen that holds one line. Write a new one and the old one is gone. Like most records.

say: MEMO 2: THE STORE HOLDS THIS LINE INSTEAD.
MEMO 3: EMPTY. NOTHING TO RECORD. RECORDED.
MEMO 1: THE STORE HOLDS THIS LINE.
MEMO SCREEN: memo 2 written. memo 1 overwritten.
MEMO SCREEN: memo 3 written. memo 2 overwritten.
MEMO SCREEN: memo 1 written. memo 3 overwritten.

devices.name: WALL PORT
devices.look: A network socket in a wall plate. It knows one machine by name. Most of us know fewer.

say: WALL PORT 3-01. KIND: LINK. KNOWN HOST: QA-SRV 01 (CONNECT WITHOUT SCAN). THE NET STATION IS BAY 3·06.

devices.name: UNIT 7
devices.look: A help kiosk with a face on its screen. A daemon lives in it. It has passed every test of being pleasant.
devices.status: DAEMON · talks · can switch the test lamp

devices.name: METRONOME
devices.look: A clock that only knows two words: tick, tock. It says them every 1.5 seconds, to nobody, unless you wire it.

say: CLOCK: tick, tock, every 1.5 s. engine verbs: start, stop. wire tick or tock to anything.
METRONOME. KIND: CLOCK. RAISES tick AND tock IN TURN, EVERY 1.5 S. LAST: {phase}.

devices.name: TAPE RECORDER
devices.look: A reel-to-reel on the bench, red light on. It records whoever looks inside it. That is its whole job and it loves it.

say: TAPE: KIND LOG. IT FILLS TRACE (6% A SECOND) WHILE YOU ARE INSIDE THE RECORDER. CUT ITS CABLE TO THE REEL, OR SWITCH IT OFF.

devices.name: TEST BUTTON
devices.look: A big button on a post. Press it and three things happen. One of them you cannot stop.

devices.name: BEACON
devices.look: An orange rotating beacon on a bracket. It means nothing yet. It is waiting for something to mean.

devices.name: HORN
devices.look: A buzzer horn on the wall. Its whole range is one note.

devices.name: PRESS COUNTER
devices.look: A counter fed through a conduit in the wall. Every press of the test button is on it. Every one.
devices.status: count: {count} · fed by a fixed conduit

say: COUNTER: {count}. FED BY A FIXED CONDUIT FROM THE TEST BUTTON. IT CANNOT BE CUT. YOU CAN TRY.

devices.name: PRESSURE PLATE
devices.look: A plate in the floor. Step on it and it says so. What happens after that is up to the wiring.

devices.name: TEST HATCH
devices.look: A door in a frame with no wall around it. It opens onto the same room. It is a door for testing doors.

devices.name: FAN
devices.look: A wall fan behind a grille. It turns when the hatch opens, because someone wired it that way in 2041.

devices.name: QA LOGIN
devices.look: A terminal on a stand with a login prompt and a sticky note on its bezel. The note is the security policy.

bay3: QA LOGIN: half. the other half is your department.

say: STICKY NOTE: "QA password: bay3-qa. do not write the password down. —QA"
TEST RESULTS, BAY 3: 41 PASSED. 2 FAILED. 1 FAILED TO REPORT FAILING (PASSED).

devices.name: SHIELD LOCKER
devices.look: A locker with a round lock of three spinning rings. Lock each ring as its gap passes the top.

say: SHIELD LOCKER: rings down. door open.
TOY: SHIELD RINGS. 3 RINGS, OUTERMOST FIRST. LOCK EACH WHILE ITS GAP IS AT THE TOP. CARDS SLOW AND PING WORK HERE.

devices.name: CIPHER BOX
devices.look: A box with a brass wheel on its lid and a line of nonsense engraved round it. The nonsense has a shift.

say: CIPHER BOX: read right. the lid lifts.
TOY: CIPHER WHEEL. TURN THE INNER RING UNTIL THE LINE READS, THEN READ IT OUT. TEST KEY: SHIFT 3.

devices.name: CRYPTEX CASE
devices.look: A brass tube of four letter rings in a cradle. Set the word and it pulls apart.

tset: CRYPTEX: those are the letters. not in that order.

say: CRYPTEX: pulled apart. one strip of paper inside: "PASS".
TOY: CRYPTEX. 4 RINGS. TEST WORD: THE THING THIS ROOM DOES.

devices.name: MORSE LAMP
devices.look: A signal lamp on a bracket, blinking the same two letters over and over. Blink them back.

say: MORSE LAMP: answer received. it stops blinking, for the first time since installation.
TOY: MORSE LAMP. WATCH IT, TAP IT BACK. TEST MESSAGE: OK (--- -.-).

devices.name: KEY CUTTER
devices.look: A key-chip cutter on a stand. One blank in, one key out. It only cuts one shape.

say: KEY CUTTER: one key chip cut. it opens drawer A of the secure cabinet.

devices.name: SECURE CABINET
devices.look: A steel cabinet with three drawers and three kinds of seal: a key, a sequence, a condition.

say: DRAWER A: KEY SEAL (bay 3 key). DRAWER B: SEQUENCE SEAL (red, green, blue by signal, within 3 s). DRAWER C: CONDITION SEAL (mains on).
DRAWER A: a calibration certificate. VALID UNTIL REVOKED.
DRAWER B: a spare red button. nobody knows why it is in here.
DRAWER C: a torch, for when the mains is off. it opens only while the mains is on.

devices.name: RGB PANEL
devices.look: Three buttons on a wall panel: red, green, blue. Each is wired to drawer B's seal.

devices.name: MAINS LEVER
devices.look: A big lever on the wall: MAINS. Drawer C opens only while it is up.

devices.name: AUDIT DESK
devices.look: A desk terminal with AUDIT over the screen and a red light that means it is writing you down.

status.then: LOG · recording to the spool · 20% a second

audit: AUDIT: close. the role, not the act.

say: AUDIT POLICY: EVERY SESSION IS LOGGED. A WRONG PASSWORD ADDS 30%. AT 100% THE SESSION ENDS AND THE DESK LOCKS FOR 8 S. PASSWORD: THE ROLE, LOWERCASE.
AUDIT: trace wiped. the wipe is not logged. the log of the wipe is.

devices.name: ARCHIVE SPOOL
devices.look: A tape spool on the wall where the audit desk sends what it writes. It turns while you are being written.
devices.status: fed by AUDIT DESK · cut the cable and it hears nothing

say: ARCHIVE SPOOL. THE AUDIT DESK RECORDS ONLY WHILE ITS CABLE REACHES THIS SPOOL.

devices.name: NET JACK
devices.look: A wall box with one port marked TEST LAN. Plug in here and the bay's network is yours to look at.

say: TEST LAN. KNOWN: QA-SRV 01. SCAN FINDS QA-PRN 2. QA-VAULT IS ONE HOP ON, THROUGH QA-SRV 01'S OWN LINK.

devices.name: NET BELL
devices.look: A bell on the wall with a cable to the server rack. QA-SRV 01 rings it when pinged.

devices.name: LABEL PRINTER
devices.look: A label printer on a cart. QA-PRN 2 sends it jobs. Everything in this bay has a label because of it.

devices.name: STAMP PRESS
devices.look: A press that stamps APPROVED on whatever is under it. The watchdog stops by every few seconds to check it is not approving the wrong things.

devices.name: CONVEYOR
devices.look: A short belt carrying boxes from nowhere to nowhere. It is on the watchdog's route; while it is checked, it stands still.

devices.name: SIREN
devices.look: A test siren on the wall. The last stop on the watchdog's walk.

devices.name: COFFEE MACHINE
devices.look: A coffee machine with a screen, a network card and opinions. It is the bay's most connected device.

say: COFFEE: descaling. 1 minute. ... done. it was fine.
COFFEE: {cups} CUPS TODAY. BEANS: SUFFICIENT. EVERY CUP IS LOGGED TO THE DRINKER'S IDENTITY.
FIRMWARE 4.0.1. CHANGELOG: "reports cups to the Registry. fixed: cups."

devices.name: CHIP READER
devices.look: A reader with a slot for blank chips. It tests a chip by eating it. The dispenser next to it has more.

say: CHIP READER: INSERT ONE BLANK CHIP (CARRIED ITEM). CHIPS TESTED: {chips}. CHIPS RETURNED: 0.

devices.name: TEST TILL
devices.look: A till that takes one noodle token and gives back a receipt. It is not for anything. It is for paying.

say: RECEIPT: {paid} TOKEN(S) RECEIVED FOR: NOTHING. VAT ON NOTHING: INCLUDED.

devices.name: NIGHT LIGHT
devices.look: A lamp on a pole by the window with a photocell on top. It may only be on between 18:00 and 06:00.

say: NIGHT LIGHT: on. it goes off by itself at 06:00.
PHOTOCELL: daylight ({hour}h). lamp not permitted until 18:00.

devices.name: WEATHER SENSOR
devices.look: A sensor on the window sill, outside the glass. It reports the weather to the Registry and, on request, to you.

say: SENSOR: RAIN. the vent stays shut.
SENSOR: STORM. the vent stays shut. stay indoors (advisory).
SENSOR: SMOG. air quality below standard. the vent stays shut.

devices.name: WINDOW VENT
devices.look: A louvred vent in the window. It will not open in rain, storm or smog, and it shuts itself when they come.

nodes.name: QA-SRV 01
nodes.look: The bay's test server, from the inside. Clean, labelled, and logging that it is clean and labelled.
nodes.status: test server · ping rings the net bell · has a link onward

say: QA-SRV 01: "you are connected. this is the test of being connected. it passed."
QA-SRV 01: pong. bell cable carries it.

nodes.name: QA-PRN 2
nodes.look: The print server. It only appears to a scan; it is not in anyone's address book.

say: QA-PRN 2: job queued to the label printer.

nodes.name: QA-VAULT
nodes.look: A store behind the test server. Reachable only through QA-SRV 01's own link: a hop.

say: QA-VAULT: "you hopped. well done. here is a fragment for the keyring."

reset.ok: BAY 3 RESET: every device back to its first state. keyring and tokens kept.
